author: IGN YouTube
text:
The Resident Evil Movie Understands Video Games Are Ridiculous, and That's Why It's Great
Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie understands that video games are ridiculous, and that's why it's great.

Video games are ridiculous. The Resident Evil series is a perfect example. One moment you’re running in terror from a comically oversized, trench-coated tank of a man in a tiny hat; the next, you’re messing around with electronic chess pieces to open a door. These are completely alien situations that, somehow, these games compel us to navigate with rational thought. This is what Zach Cregger understands so well about Capcom’s genre-defining series. His Resident Evil movie knows this is ridiculous, so it lets its lead, Brian, progress through a 90-minute rollercoaster just as we would with a controller in our hands. It’s a fantastic translation of the sensation of playing a survival horror game, never forgetting to include every piece of glorious nonsense that comes with it.

How Golden Axe Adapts A Video Game Mythology No One Knows
Sega's side-scrolling brawler may be a storied game franchise, but it's not exactly known for its story. Golden Axe showrunners Mike McMahan and Joe Chandler and stars Matthew Rhys, Liam McIntyre, Danny Pudi, and Carl Tart join IGN's Tom Jorgensen to explain how that was the perfect place to start building the show's mythology and how they incorporate video game logic into both the comedy and action. Matthew Rhys also reveals who he thinks his friend Conan O'Brien should play in Golden Axe Season 2.

text:
Twitch CEO Expects GTA Online 2 in 2027 - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Twitch CEO Dan Clancy thinkgs GTA 6's grip on gaming culture won't let up even into next year, when he says GTA 6 2 will launch. Via Bloomberg, Clancy said we'll see a "big bump with GTA 6," but also another huge one when multiplayer drops next year. Rockstar has not formally announced their GTA Online plans post-GTA 6, but it's all but inevitable GTA Online continues with GTA 6 as the framework, much like how GTA 5 was the foundation for GTA Online. Parent company Take-Two, for its part, is ready to support the current iteration of GTA Online as long as gamers want to keep playing it. In other news, The Blood of Dawnwalker will get a New Game+ mode eventually, according to the game's director. And Gen-Xers and Millenials rejoice! Toys 'R' Us is making a big retail push this holiday season, opening 120 new standalone stores that will cater to nostalgic adults and today's content creators.
